tasks.label: Build Work Hours Tracker
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null; javac --add-modules jdk.httpserver -d out (Get-ChildItem -Recurse src/main/java/*.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })

tasks.label: Run Work Hours Tracker
args: if (-not (Test-Path out)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null; javac --add-modules jdk.httpserver -d out (Get-ChildItem -Recurse src/main/java/*.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }) }; java --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp out app.Main
